content: Bemar Bab-Dummad-mimmigan gwallu-meegwad gumalad
Degisoggu, bemar Bab-Dummad-mimmigan-sabesailadmarsoggu, Bab-Dummad-daedba be damarsun.
Degi, sabguedgi be nanamar, ar igi Cristo anmar-sabgusmoga, degine, ise-wawadik Bab-Dummadga ibmar-ogumakar-uklegedyob anmar-ular na e-san uksamoga, ayob be nanamar.
Ar bemar Jesucristoʼgi be akananaimarsoggu, bipisaale, bemargi we-ibmar soglegewilubsulid:
Deginbali, melle weyob be sunmako:

content.text: Suli, we-gaya-degimalad, ibnuedsulid. Bur Bab-Dummadga dog-nuedye, be sogmar.

content: Ar bato bemar wisid, dule abirgunagwarsuli-na-negsichigi-yolediidi, dule galagwensuli-gudiidi, degi, dule dogdar-ibmarbina-surbinsa-itodiidi, (we-ibmar e-bab-dummadga na imakdiid), Cristo-negdakmaidse, degi, Bab-Dummad-e-negdakmaidse, doged-igar ega gwen maisulid.
Mer dulemar-emar-binsaed-gaega yogasaar-sunmakmaladse be yardaklemalo. Ar Bab-Dummad, eba-dasurmalad galagwensulidaedbali, sabsur-odurdakdedaed.
Degisoggu, amar-degidamaladbali, mer eba ibmar-isgana be imakmar.
Ar epennedi, bemar negsichigi galagwensuli gudigusmalanad. Ar emigindi, bemar, Bab-Jesúsʼgi neg-meegwadgi gudimalad. Degisoggu, Bab-Dummad-mag-daked-dule na be san oyomar,
(ar Bab-Dummad-mag-daked-dule weyob daed: Bela igar-nuegangi nanae, igar-innikigwadbi imake, degine, igar-napiragwadbi sae),
degi, be durdakbarmarsun, igid-igar Bab-Jesús-nabir-ito imakedi.
Mer ibmar-isgana-negsichidgi-imaklemalad be imakmar. Dulemar-deyob-ibmar-imakmaladga bur be oyoge, emarde nue nodimarye.
Ar ade, bemar we-dulemar-ibmar-isgana-dukuar-imakdiidgi-sunmakedbela ibnuedsulid, agi be sunmaked be binge-itogewilubbid.
Ar bela ibmar gwallu-meegwadse onolesale, mag dakledaed, we-ibmar ibmar-isganamarye. Ar gwallu bela ibmar-mag-dakle imaked.
Ar a-ulale, sogleged:
Degisoggu, be-daedgine nue be nanamarsun, melle dule-ibmar-wissurmaladyob be damar, dule-nue-ibmar-wisidyob be nanamarsun.
Ibagan-nagumaidgi nue egi be gudii imakmar, ar ibagan-isganade bukidargusad.
Degisoggu, melle binsaedsuli be nanamar. Aka bur be Bab-Jesús igi-nanabi bemar-abemai, a bur be imakdii gumar.
Degine, melle be mumgumar. Ar mumguedi, galagwensuli dule-onanae imaked. Bur bela-bela Bab-Dummad-Burba-Isligwaledse-seledii na be imakmar.

content.text: degi, Bab-Jesús-nug ogannodii be-gwagegi be imakmarsun.
Anmar-Bab-Jesucristo-nuggi, Bab-Dummad-anmar-babga, bela dogdar-nuedye sogdigu be imakmarsun.
Bab-Dummad-dobekwaa-nanaedgi na be muchub-muchub urbaligwa-nanadii gumalo.

content: Ome sui-urbaligwa nanaoed, degi, sui nue ome-sabgumogoed
Omegan-sui-nikmalad, na be-sui-urbaligwa nanamar. Igi Bab-Jesús-urbalikwaa be nanadimala, deyob be-sui-urbaligwa be nanamar.
Ar sui, ome-e-dummadga gued. Deyobi, Cristo na eba-nanaimalad-e-dummadga gumogad. Degi, Cristo, eba-nanaimalad-e-Abonogedga gubalid. Degisoggu, Jesúsʼba-nanaimalad, Cristo-e-sanga gusiid.
Degisoggu, ar igi Cristoʼba-nanaimalad Cristo-sogedba nanadii, debayobi omegan e-sui-urbaligwa bela nanamogoed.
Ar igi Cristo na eba-nanaimalad-sabgusa, degine, Bab-Dummadgadga-imakega eba-nanaimaladbina-burgwisa, deyobi, machergan, be-ome na be sabgumar.
Ar Cristo, deyob eba-nanaimalad E-Gayaburba-sogedba, degi, Bab-diigi-ogleged-igar-imaklegedba swilidik imaksad.
Adi, Cristo, eba-nanaimalad nue-swilidikidgi, isgued-naisulidgi, bela yeerdaklege, gwen gutu-naisuli, bapi-bapidsuli, bela nued-daklege, deyob na ega-ukega, na eba-nanaimalad-imaksad.
Ar sui, igi Cristo na eba-nanaimalad-sabgue, deyob, na e-ome-sabgumogargebed. Ar sui, igi na e-san sabgue, deyob, na e-ome-sabgumogo. Ar dule na e-ome-sabele, dukin na e-san sabgued.
Ar dule bipisaale e-san geg na isdardaked, bur bule e-san na nued akwed, degi, nue na masgi ogunbalid. Ar deyob, Cristo na eba-nanaimalad-imakmogad.
Ar ade, anmar Cristo-e-san-mesadid. Anmar, e-san gued, degi, e-galagan gued.
Génesis 2:24
We wargwenna-gunonidaedi, igar-dummadid, nue aku itolegedid. We degi-an-sogedi, Cristo, degine, na eba-nanaimalad-ebo-igar-maidgi an deyob soged.
Degisoggu, bemar na wala-walagwen, ar igi na-be-san-sabmala, deyob na-be be-ome sabgumogoed. Degine, ome, e-suigi binsaed-nikaa nanadii guoed.
